why: Restore the Highway 101 SovOil station’s ordinary truck-stop variants. The kept Inland Avenue phase supplies its diner staff, visitors and mechanics.

open_questions: The direction of the #loc_q104_gas_station_devices q104 variant is inferred, not proven: q104.questphase sets q104=0 before the station chapter and the dev debug setup forces q104=1. Confirm on the tour that no mines, turret props or courier dressing are visible at the peaceful station.

Whether the glass door and the sliding door really have no in-world opener (no terminal, keycard or skill check turned up in the venue's phases); the tour's look-at log and the DoorPolicy lines decide it.

The kept open-world phase bad_ina_phase already activates #loc_q104_gas_station_ow_com (both None/None and None/default, plus a Deactivate) on branches the miner marks ungated, so this venue may already be populated before our phase runs. Our re-issue is the rule-6 boot+proximity safety net; the tour should confirm the crowd is not doubled.
Whether the shutters (q104_gas_station_shutter_03/04) and the garage gates start down or open in the clean slate, since only the siege phases drive them.
Whether the upper floor / room behind the counter stays reachable without the questdesign prefab and its anders_blocker variant.

variant_toggles.why: Normal, undamaged station dressing. Every non-quest path sets default=1 and q104_station=0; the quest look (q104_station=1, default=0) is what the debug shortcut into the q104 chapter turns on, so it is the occupied/damaged state we do not want.
The nomad-convoy arrival soundbed belongs to the Aldecaldo reinforcements scene, which never happens here; the station should have its plain ambient audio.

Keep the station on its pre-quest device set so no quest-only pieces (mines, the courier door's dressing, the combat garage setup) are shown at a peaceful station. q104=0 is the state q104.questphase itself sets before the station chapter; q104=1 is what the dev debug setup (fact q104_TEST_debug_mode_on) forces for quest testing. The kept open-world phase bad_ina_phase also toggles this node, so pinning it makes the result deterministic.

deferred_prefab_owner: world streaming (the chosen people need no quest prefab)

proximity_wait.why: The glass front door of the station, the door a customer walks through into the shop/diner where the crowd's spots are; it is a DoorControllerPS in the venue's device prefab and vanilla itself drives it (ForceUnlock), so it streams in with the venue and a player standing at the entrance is within the wait radius.
